Chamber_GRCop42_regen.note: L-PBF GRCop-42 liner + ribs (95 kg) with Inconel 718 closeout (64 kg); channels modelled in PicoGK

Nozzle_In718_regen.note: channel-wall nozzle eps 12-34, liner+ribs 124 kg, closeout 29 kg

Coolant_outlet_manifold.note: collects chamber circuit A at the injector end; D-section printed onto the jacket (I2)

Coolant_inlet_manifold_nozzle.note: split-flow inlet at the liner joint (eps 12); feeds circuit B down the nozzle and the jumpers

Coolant_distribution_manifold_chamber.note: feeds circuit A up the copper chamber

Coolant_exit_manifold.note: collects circuit B at the nozzle exit; stiffens the exit lip

Injector_AM_single_piece.note: single-piece L-PBF injector (I4): plenum, faceplate, 173 posts, interpropellant plate

Ox_dome.note: ox-rich gas dome, carries thrust to the gimbal pad

LOX_turbine_housing.note: turbine inlet housing; welded to preburner

LOX_kick_stage_housing.note: kick stage: +32 bar for the ox flow to the FPB

LOX_pump_volute_casing.note: pump casing and volute; welded (no ISO bolt pattern fits)

LOX_preburner_shell.note: ox-rich preburner 900 K, 688 bar, tau 3 ms

LOX_laser_igniter.note: laser ignition head, sapphire window, fibre-fed (N2); no GOX/GCH4 supply

CH4_turbine_housing.note: turbine inlet housing; welded to preburner

CH4_pump_volute_casing.note: pump casing and volute; welded (no ISO bolt pattern fits)

CH4_preburner_shell.note: fuel-rich preburner 1200 K, 716 bar, tau 8 ms

CH4_laser_igniter.note: laser ignition head, sapphire window, fibre-fed (N2); no GOX/GCH4 supply

Ox_hot_gas_weld.note: ox_hot_gas: collector welded to the injector inlet through a short spool (I1)

Fuel_hot_gas_weld.note: fuel_hot_gas: collector welded to the injector inlet through a short spool (I1)

CH4_discharge_duct.note: CH4 pump -> MFV -> jacket inlet manifold

Nozzle_return_duct.note: jacket circuit B -> FPB (orificed to circuit A pressure)

Fuel_crossfeed_tee.note: tee boss on the CH4 discharge duct
